title: MSN-04 SAZABI VER. KA MG (SPECIAL COATING)
summary: This is my first timelapse video of assembling a gunpla kit even when this is already my 5th MG. It was fun trying to experience different viewpoints and shots but the end result seems to be a beautiful mess to me alone. This kit is really worth a shot at regardless of Bandai or Daban. Sazabi is really one of a kind when it comes to gunpla. The special coating is, yeah, glorious icing on the cake.
